claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G lens; no origin/usage history is visible.
Photos show the lens exterior text, but do not clearly confirm absence of scratches, fungus, haze, oil, or internal dust.
Witness read “50mm 1/8G” (i.e., 50mm 1.8G) and “AF-S NIKKOR” from the lens barrel in photos 0–2.

risks.risk: Glass condition issues (scratches, fungus, haze, oil film) that reduce image quality; photos don’t clearly verify cleanliness.
risks.proof: A bright-angle photo of both front and rear elements plus a macro shot of the glass surface (and any visible specks) with the lens held still; also a wipe-test/inspection under light.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible cosmetic/optical wear (worst-case: not guaranteed clean).

risks.risk: Autofocus or aperture may be faulty or inconsistent (no functional test shown).
risks.proof: Short video showing autofocus lock on a nearby subject and aperture changes (e.g., from f/1.8 to f/4) on a working Nikon body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not tested for AF/aperture performance (worst-case: may require repair).

risks.risk: Lens mount damage or play/wobble (contacts/threads not shown clearly).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear mount/contacts and threads, plus a clip showing the lens seated on a camera with no wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mount condition unknown (worst-case: possible fit/connection issues).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (front/rear caps and/or hood) affecting usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included items laid out (caps/hood/box) and a shot of the lens with caps attached.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming accessories may be missing.

risks.risk: Exact version/compatibility uncertainty beyond readable markings (e.g., confirmation of AF-S 50mm 1.8G details/serial).
risks.proof: Photo of the full barrel markings including any additional text and a clear serial number (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Priced based on the readable identification only (worst-case: treat as generic used 50mm 1.8G without extra confirmation).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the front and rear glass under strong light (including macro shots) to confirm no fungus/haze/oil/scratches.
Provide a short video test: autofocus lock and aperture actuation on a Nikon body.
Send a close-up of the rear mount/contacts and threads, plus a clip showing the lens seated with no wobble.
Confirm what’s included: front cap, rear cap, hood, and any box/paperwork (photos of all items laid out).
Send a photo of the full barrel markings and serial number (if available) for exact version confirmation.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition; the seller’s “like new/clean” claim is not verifiable from the provided photos.
